messages:
Maya (Docs): Opening a docs PR to deprecate `event_type_v1` in favor of `event_category` + `event_action`. Need migration snippets, SOC2-safe retention phrasing, and SDK coordination. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1203
Liam (Eng): Include a short migration appendix and ops one-liner. Call out consumer index implications so integrators know if re-indexing is needed.
Maya (Docs): Will add a jq one-liner and a Node streaming example, plus a breaking-change note in the changelog.
Sophia (Security): SOC2 wording: "Records are retained for a configurable retention period (default 90 days) and may be retained longer where required by law or customer agreement." Link to canonical retention policy.
Alex (SDK): SDK plan: compatibility shim mapping `event_type_v1` -> `event_category` for two minor releases, emit `X-Audit-Deprecation: event_type_v1`. I'll open JS/Go/Ruby PRs after docs land.
doc-bot: PR opened by Maya (Docs): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1203 — reviewers requested: @Liam, @Alex (SDK)
Liam (Eng): jq suggestion for appendix: ```jq '.event_category = (.event_type_v1 // .event_category) | del(.event_type_v1)' input.jsonl > output.jsonl```
Maya (Docs): Adding that and the Node snippet. Checklist before merge: update API examples, add migration snippets, SOC2 phrasing per Sophia, link legal retention, cross-link SDK PRs.
Sophia (Security): Ping me after edits; I'll do final compliance sign-off.
Alex (SDK): ETA for SDK PRs EOD tomorrow; will include tests and deprecation logs.
Maya (Docs): Targeting review in 2 hours and merge by Fri COB. Thanks :thumbsup:
